input_fields.name: expected_property
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `property_name`, `expected_value`, and `relation` for one observable property.

input_fields.name: measurement_method
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `source_ref`, `method`, `unit`, and `evidence_layer` for measuring that property.

input_fields.name: tolerance
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `value`, `unit`, and `comparison` for the acceptance test.

result_fields.name: assertion_definition
result_fields.description: Object with required keys `property`, `measurement_method`, `units`, `tolerance`, `pass_rule`, `fail_rule`, and `unknown_measurement_rule`; nullable when the common output envelope records missing assertion inputs.

procedure: Reduce the request to one observable property and verify that its expected condition is stated without hidden geometry assumptions.
Bind the property to the supplied measurement method, units, tolerance, and evidence layer.
Define explicit pass, fail, and unavailable-measurement outcomes without changing the model or source data.
Return `assertion_definition` as action data and place status, provenance ownership, and any unresolved fields in the common output envelope.
rejection_rules: Reject a non-observable expectation or a bundle of multiple independent properties.
Reject incompatible units, invalid tolerances, or a measurement method that is not supplied or traceable.
Do not treat an assertion definition as a measurement result and do not allow the assertion to mutate geometry.
